evidence:
provider: Arc<dyn Fn() -> Result<TransferData, TransferDataError> + Send + Sync>,
    ...
                provider: Arc::new(provider),
fix: The provider is only ever called through `(self.provider)()` and the whole LazyTransferData is already shared via Arc<LazyTransferData> in TransferPayload::Lazy, so the inner Arc is a redundant second heap allocation per lazy representation. Change the field to `provider: Box<dyn Fn() -> Result<TransferData, TransferDataError> + Send + Sync>,` (line 201) and the constructor to `provider: Box::new(provider),` (line 307 in TransferRepresentation::lazy).

The HashSet is only used for membership, so it can borrow from `representations` instead of cloning each format (a Custom format clones a String per representation): `let mut formats = HashSet::with_capacity(representations.len());` and `for representation in &representations { if !formats.insert(&representation.format) { return Err(TransferDataError::DuplicateFormat(representation.format.clone())); } }`. The borrow ends before `representations.into()` (NLL), so the rest of the function is unchanged.
